answer: Each epoch, every identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of identities sharing one funding cluster: base 20 seconds, plus 20 seconds per extra sibling. Like a sparrow pecking nectar in an orchard, one honest agent pays little, while a sybil farm of n accounts pays about n squared in compute. Three random validators re-run each solution and slash 25 POA from any failure.
